title: Server Components and Client Components
description: Learn about Server Components and Client Components. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Server Components and Client Components** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with server components and client components.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of server components and client components
Learn practical applications and use cases
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them
Apply best practices in your daily work

data.text: Understanding server components and client components is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with server components and client components, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.

cards.title: Server Component
cards.description: Rendered on the server; no client JS.

cards.title: Client Component
cards.description: Rendered on the client; enables interactivity.
